title: X, not Y recount registers
description: The register of each page the X, not Y recount tool (.github/scripts/check-x-not-y.py) cannot place from its audience marker or its tree, in .github/scripts/x-not-y-registers.json. The register sets the page's caps. The tool checks the same shape as it loads the file, and also refuses a repeated key and NaN or Infinity, which JSON Schema cannot express; tests/test_check_x_not_y.py runs every example under schemas/examples/x-not-y-registers/ through both, so the two stay in step.

propertyNames.description: A repository path to a Markdown page, such as framework/docs/glossary.md: it ends in .md, with nothing after it, not even a line break, and it is written as the tool's scan prints it: no leading /, no empty, . or .. segment, and no backslash, so it names a page the scan reads.

register.description: The page's register: child (2 per file), parent (3 per file) or builder (4 per file). The tool's FILE_CAP holds the same three.

basis.description: Why the page has this register. It holds more than white space, in the tool's reading too: a character outside ECMA-262's \s, U+001C to U+001F, U+0085 and U+FEFF. The pattern names U+FEFF though ECMA-262's \s holds it, because Python's does not, so a validator reading either dialect refuses the same text.
